title: My mallworld dream is morphing...
content: I awoke with a start, my heart racing with a sense of urgency. I had to get to the mall. In a blur, I raced to my garage and jumped into the driver's seat. The engine roared to life as I blazed down the empty predawn streets. As I drove, I noticed the highway signs reading Route 24 and Route 61. The airport was within reach. I drifted around corners, the landscape a dark smear as I pushed the gas pedal to the floor. At the airport, I am met by two friends. The three of us rushed through check-in and security thanks to our privileged traveler's card. Settling into my seat just as the aircraft taxied down the runway, I watched the earth fall away as we climbed into the brightening morning sky. A few hours later, we landed in a sprawling city in the desert. After claiming our bags, we jumped into a cab and directed it towards the largest casino I could find. Time to win some extra cash for my quest. At the slot machines, luck was on my side. I caught the eye of a waitress and ordered an expensive champagne, intoxicated by my winnings. But I couldn't revel too long. I had a mission. After gambling, my friends and I ate at the casino's upscale restaurant to celebrate our winnings. The food was delicious but time was running short. By the time we left the casino, the sun was setting and it was too late to make it to the mall. I booked a luxury suite in the casino hotel, planning to continue my quest in the morning.
